authoring.what this is: the introduction survey. a deterministic, no-AI list of facet questions. each option carries authored channels; on pick they round up into the RawPortrait, which a downstream AI condenses into the final Portrait. that AI is GIVEN these definitions — so write each fragment to STAND ON ITS OWN. do not prefix it to announce its category (no 'they tend to…', no 'often…'), and do not label identities (no 'THE STRIVER —'). write as if the category is already understood.
authoring.indicator: a fact, localized in the present — what is true of this person right now, given this answer. near-certain.
authoring.implication: speculation — one possible lead. implications are NOT mutually exclusive and need not agree with each other; each is a read the downstream AI can weigh.
authoring.identity: archetypal-trait fragments describing the kind of person who lands here. plural, and they can compete. NO names or labels — just the trait, bare.
authoring.weight: 0-3. how hot this answer runs — emotional + meaningful valence. 0 inert (the cold baseline pick), 1 mild, 2 warm (a real lead), 3 hot (load-bearing). it ONLY sorts the RawPortrait amalgam (high signal rises, low sinks). it NEVER gates, filters, or drops anything. author per-answer — do NOT flatten to a constant or it sorts nothing.
authoring.shadow: critical. what it means that they did NOT pick this — collected from every option they declined. one line, no announcing prefix; read it as the meaning of the omission.
authoring.hooks: RELATIONAL. fires pairwise against OTHER answers. empty for now.
authoring.notes: DIRECTIVE / operational. not load-bearing right now — leave empty.
authoring._note: unchanged facets still carry the old labelled seeds — placeholders to be rewritten in the clean style above. the new facets (relationship-status, work, social, joys, change) show the target style.

facets.question: how are the basics right now? housing, money, health
facets.hidden_target: material ground — recalibrates every other answer

options.label: handled
implications: stress they name later is more likely existential than situational
identities: the secure base — here for meaning, not rescue
options.shadow: the ground isn't actually settled

options.label: mostly
indicators: basics broadly held, with one live edge
implications: one domain — housing, money, or health — is quietly straining
identities: the steady-but-watchful
options.shadow: no quiet strain in the background — it's either fine or it's loud

options.label: some are slipping
indicators: real strain in at least one basic domain
implications: later flatness may be situational, not dispositional
identities: the quietly-precarious — holding it together in public
options.shadow: the strain isn't partial — it's either handled or total

options.label: barely — survival mode
implications: any fork sits on top of survival pressure
identities: the in-the-storm — needs ground before depth
options.shadow: survival isn't the crisis; the weight is elsewhere

facets.question: and your heart — where is it these days?
facets.hidden_target: relational orientation — not just status, but the vector toward it or away from it

options.label: happily single
indicators: single, and not looking to change it
implications: their charges likely sit outside romance — work, self, family
identities: doesn't feel unfinished without a partner
options.shadow: there's a pull toward someone they're not naming

options.label: single, and looking
indicators: single and open to meeting someone
implications: romance is a live, low background hum
identities: out in the world, hopeful, available
options.shadow: they're not in the market right now

options.label: waiting for the one
indicators: single, holding out for something real
implications: wants it badly; the waiting may be wearing on them
identities: particular about love, unwilling to settle or fake it
options.shadow: they'd take something casual; no standard is being held

options.label: with someone
implications: a partner is woven through their days
identities: paired; someone shares the weight of their life
options.shadow: no one currently shares the center

options.label: married
indicators: married, or committed for the long arc
implications: the questions land against a shared, built life
identities: in it for the long haul, by choice or by inertia
options.shadow: their bond isn't formal or long-running

options.label: it's complicated
indicators: romantic life is unresolved or tangled
implications: a live relational charge sits near the surface
identities: in something undefined, ending, or overlapping
options.shadow: their situation is clear, not knotted

options.label: fresh out of something
implications: grief or relief is recent and probably loud
identities: in the raw after, re-learning themselves alone
options.shadow: no recent ending is shadowing them

facets.question: most days, the work you actually do feels like—

options.label: mine, i'd choose it
implications: the doing matches the wanting
identities: the called — work is a source, not a drain
options.shadow: the work isn't theirs in the way they'd want

options.label: fine, pays the bills
implications: healthy detachment or quiet resignation — undetermined
identities: the pragmatist OR the resigned
options.shadow: work is more than neutral — it's loved or hated

options.label: a slog, running empty
implications: misaligned and draining; possibly trapped
identities: the depleted — grinding past the point it pays back
options.shadow: work isn't actively draining them

options.label: i'm between things right now
indicators: between roles, or between work entirely
implications: work-identity is unsettled; a transition is underway or overdue
identities: in motion around work, not yet landed
options.shadow: their working life is settled, for better or worse

facets.question: a party where you only know the host. ten minutes in, you're—
facets.hidden_target: social reflex under mild exposure — what the body does before the self-image catches up

options.label: working the room
implications: new people are fuel, not a tax
identities: comes alive in a room full of strangers
options.shadow: a room of strangers isn't where they expand

options.label: finding the one person you can actually talk to
indicators: seeks one real conversation over many shallow ones
implications: the crowd is a means to a single connection
identities: goes deep with one before wide with many
options.shadow: they don't hunt for the one real talk — they spread out or leave

options.label: helping the host, finding a job to do
indicators: gets comfortable by being useful, not by being seen
implications: usefulness is a way to be present without being exposed
identities: earns a place in the room by helping, not by holding court
options.shadow: they don't need a task to feel okay in a room

options.label: already clocking the exit
indicators: the social load registers as cost within minutes
implications: will perform presence, then need to recover
identities: counts the minutes until they can leave, even somewhere fine
options.shadow: the room doesn't start a countdown for them

facets.question: is there something you make?
facets.hidden_target: creative identity — what they make, hide, or have lost

options.label: yes, and i love it
indicators: an active making practice they claim
implications: a real source of aliveness and identity
identities: makes things, and lets it count
options.shadow: making isn't a live thread for them right now

options.label: yes — but i'd never call it that
indicators: makes things but won't claim the title
implications: the practice exists; the permission to own it doesn't
identities: creates quietly, deflects the word for it
options.shadow: if they make, they own it — or they don't make at all

options.label: not really
implications: aliveness, if it's anywhere, isn't in making
identities: finds themselves somewhere other than in making
options.shadow: there's a maker in here, claimed or hidden

options.label: i used to
indicators: a making practice that has stopped
implications: a specific creative grief; something got set down
identities: carries a put-down practice and the ache of it
options.shadow: their making is current, not past tense

facets.question: a day opens up with nothing in it. you—
facets.hidden_target: can you be without doing (mirror of yearning)

options.label: tackle the list
indicators: can't rest; output-driven even in freedom
implications: worth is likely staked on productivity
identities: THE STRIVER — rest feels like a debt owed
options.shadow: open time isn't immediately filled with doing

options.label: finally rest, guilt-free
implications: healthy relationship with stillness
identities: the at-ease — worth isn't staked on doing
options.shadow: rest doesn't come guilt-free

options.label: pretend to relax but stay half-on
implications: anxious activation under the stillness
identities: the half-on — vigilance dressed as leisure
options.shadow: they can actually switch off — or can't even pretend to

options.label: don't know what to do with myself
implications: empty time is threatening
identities: the unstructured-anxious — no compass for open time
options.shadow: they have a compass for open time

facets.question: your body is more a temple, a tool, or a problem?

options.label: a temple i tend
indicators: a reverent, invested relationship with the body
implications: cares for it; can tip into control
identities: the tender — OR the controlling-careful
options.shadow: the body isn't tended with reverence

options.label: a tool that gets me through
indicators: a utilitarian relationship to the body
implications: the body serves function; low felt relationship
identities: the utilitarian
options.shadow: the body is more than a means to an end

options.label: a problem i manage
indicators: the body is an ongoing struggle
implications: health, image, or chronic issue is live
identities: the at-war — the body is a battleground
options.shadow: the body isn't a daily struggle

options.label: a stranger, i'm barely in it
implications: lives up in the head; the not-noticing is the signal
identities: the disembodied
options.shadow: they're present in the body, not above it

facets.question: when something in your life goes stale, you—
facets.hidden_target: how they meet the stale — and the fork they came in carrying

options.label: blow it up — make a big change
indicators: meets staleness with a big, decisive move
implications: decisive, or impulsive — the aftermath tells which
identities: would rather detonate it than sit in it
options.shadow: they don't blow things up; they tweak, wait, or endure

options.label: adjust something, tweak it
indicators: meets staleness by tuning, not overhauling
implications: controlled and careful; trusts small corrections
identities: changes by increments, keeps the frame intact
options.shadow: small adjustments don't satisfy them — they leap or they endure

options.label: wait for it to shift on its own
indicators: lets staleness sit, waits for it to move
implications: low change-agency; may be stuck at a fork
identities: waits for the situation to decide instead of deciding
options.shadow: they don't wait it out — they act, one way or another

options.label: stick it out, endure it
indicators: stays in the stale and bears it
implications: high discomfort-tolerance — loyal, or trapped
identities: endures what others would leave, by choice or by habit
options.shadow: they don't just endure — they change or they wait

facets.question: when you're angry, it tends to come out—

options.label: hot, i let it out
implications: volatile or honest, depending on the aftermath
identities: the hot — anger goes out, not in
options.shadow: anger doesn't come out loud

options.label: cold, i go distant
implications: punishes through absence
identities: the cold-shoulder — aggression in retreat
options.shadow: withdrawal isn't the anger move

options.label: it doesn't, i swallow it
implications: turned inward or somatized; the missing anger is the tell
identities: the swallower — anger pointed at the self
options.shadow: the anger has an outlet

options.label: depends who it's with
implications: safe with some, suppressed with others — a hierarchy
identities: the selective — anger maps the safety map
options.shadow: anger isn't relationship-gated — it's consistent

facets.question: when someone you love goes quiet, you—

options.label: reach out
implications: anxious-leaning; low tolerance for the unread
identities: the pursuer — closes the distance
options.shadow: silence isn't met by pursuit

options.label: wait
implications: secure space-giving OR avoidant non-chase — undetermined
identities: the waiter — secure or avoidant
options.shadow: they don't give space — they move

options.label: assume the worst
implications: abandonment hypervigilance
identities: the catastrophizer — silence means leaving
options.shadow: silence doesn't trip catastrophe

options.label: let it go
implications: genuine non-attachment OR self-protective preemption
identities: the releaser — settled or pre-emptively walled
options.shadow: they don't release — they hold on

facets.question: fastest way to ruin your whole day?

options.label: being criticized
implications: criticism lands on the foundation, not the surface
identities: the competence-staked — being wrong is the wound
options.shadow: worth isn't pinned to being right

options.label: being dismissed
indicators: worth runs through mattering and recognition
implications: the wound is invisibility
identities: the unseen — needs to be taken seriously
options.shadow: invisibility isn't the wound

options.label: letting someone down
implications: the people-pleaser tell, sideways
identities: the disappointer-fearing — worth is in not-failing-others
options.shadow: worth isn't pinned to not-failing-others

options.label: a day i wasted
implications: an unproductive day registers as a moral failing
identities: THE STRIVER — worth staked on achievement
THE FLEEING-ONE — stays busy to outrun something
options.shadow: worth isn't pinned to output

facets.question: picture going home where you grew up. the feeling in your chest—

options.label: warmth
indicators: a secure origin; home is a resource
implications: the healthy backstop — and likely real
identities: the secure-rooted
options.shadow: home isn't simply a resource

options.label: tightness, i brace
indicators: home activates old roles or tension
implications: a wound with an address
identities: the bracer — old roles reassert at home
options.shadow: home doesn't make them brace

options.label: heaviness
implications: absence, estrangement, or what it wasn't
identities: the grieving — home is loss
options.shadow: the origin isn't heavy with grief

options.label: not much, i don't go back
implications: peaceful detachment OR active avoidance — the flatness may be protective
identities: the estranged — detached or avoidant
options.shadow: they still go back; there's a live tie

facets.question: which of these do you want most?
facets.hidden_target: the altar — each want inverts to a fear

options.label: love
implications: inverts to a fear of being unlovable or abandoned
identities: the love-hungry
options.shadow: connection isn't the deepest want right now

options.label: freedom
implications: inverts to a fear of constraint or entrapment
identities: the freedom-seeker
options.shadow: they're not chafing against constraint

options.label: wisdom
implications: inverts to a fear of being foolish or deceived
identities: the seeker — often mid-transition
options.shadow: understanding isn't the hunger

options.label: beauty
implications: inverts to a fear of decay or invisibility
identities: the aesthete
options.shadow: aliveness and aesthetics aren't the ache

options.label: security
implications: inverts to a fear of chaos; read against basics
identities: the ground-seeker
options.shadow: stability isn't what's missing

options.label: belonging
implications: inverts to a fear of exile or not-enough-for-the-group
identities: the belonging-hungry — collectivist-shaped, not deficient
options.shadow: the group isn't the hunger

options.label: power
implications: inverts to a fear of powerlessness or humiliation
identities: the agency-hungry
options.shadow: agency and impact aren't the want

options.label: health
implications: a concrete need; often surfaces after a scare or a gray stretch
identities: the depleted-or-ill — wants the body back
options.shadow: the body isn't what they're reaching for

options.label: peace
indicators: wants internal quiet more than anything external
implications: likely worn down; peace is the want of someone carrying a lot
identities: reaching for stillness, not for more
options.shadow: stillness isn't the ache — they want something louder

options.label: something i can't name
implications: post-religious / pre-arrived — the highest-signal want
identities: the searching — between altars
options.shadow: the want is nameable; they're not between frames

facets.question: closest to true about how your life has gone—

options.label: i made it what it is
indicators: a strong internal locus of control
implications: a life that has rewarded effort; may miss where effort wasn't the variable
identities: THE SELF-MADE — authorship as identity
THE CONTROLLER — grip born of a fear of helplessness
options.shadow: they don't fully claim authorship

options.label: a lot was luck & timing
indicators: an external locus on their own outcomes
implications: at peace with it, or quietly defeated — adjacent answers disambiguate
identities: the humble-grateful OR the quietly-defeated
options.shadow: they don't credit chance

options.label: played a bad hand well
indicators: the stoic split — determinist on circumstance, free-will on response
implications: carries a hardship they're quietly proud of having met
identities: the stoic-resilient — already holds the mirror frame
options.shadow: they don't frame it as resilience

options.label: still not sure how much was me
indicators: genuine uncertainty about their own causal role
implications: often mid-reckoning — a recent event unsettled a story they told
identities: the reckoning — destabilized, re-sorting
options.shadow: they have a settled story about their role
